node.title: KoalaBear degree-five decomposition exclusion
node.closure: Riemann-Hurwitz saturation plus deployed-field cyclotomic exclusion
node.statement: The inner-degree-five row of the KoalaBear degree-60 endpoint decomposition is impossible. Its two index-five source points exhaust Riemann-Hurwitz, making the inner map geometrically a fifth-power map with deployed-field domain normalization. Since p=2130706433 is 3 mod 5, gcd(5,p^6-1)=1 and fifth power is injective on P1(F_(p^6)), contradicting the required complete fiber of five distinct rational active roots. The remaining necessary degrees are 2,3,4,6,10,12,30; no owner, charge, cap 68, u2 close, or row close is claimed.
